text: みんな　ビリビリ　シビレて　うごけナーイ！

structure.jp: ビリビリ　シビレて

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here the first is the reason for the second. シビレて　うごけナーイ = 'paralyzed, and so can't move'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing うごく 'move' to うごける gives 'can move', and ない makes it 'cannot'. ナーイ is ない stretched out in the speaker's foreigner-style voice. うごけナーイ = 'can't moove'.
